# SC Market

> SC Market is the Star Citizen marketplace where players buy, sell and trade in-game items and hire orgs for services such as hauling, escort, medical rescue and salvage. All trades are in aUEC (in-game currency); no real money is involved. It is a fan-made community site, not affiliated with Cloud Imperium Games or Roberts Space Industries.

Pages are rendered in the browser; the public pages below also serve a plain-HTML summary to clients that don't run JavaScript. Machine-readable data is available from the public REST API.

## Marketplace

- [Marketplace](https://sc-market.space/market): items for sale and buy orders from players and orgs
- [Shops](https://sc-market.space/shops): player and org storefronts
- [Services](https://sc-market.space/market/services): services offered by players and orgs
- [Contractors](https://sc-market.space/contractors): orgs and contractors and their ratings
- [Recruiting](https://sc-market.space/recruiting): org recruiting posts

## Game database

- [Game database](https://sc-market.space/wiki): items, ships, commodities, locations and manufacturers
- [Items](https://sc-market.space/wiki/items)

- [Commodities](https://sc-market.space/wiki/commodities)
- [Star map and locations](https://sc-market.space/wiki/locations)

- [Missions](https://sc-market.space/missions)
